verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents built-in brute-force detection with automatic temporary/permanent account lockout on repeated login failures, directly addressing brute-force/credential-stuffing protection on auth flows. This is corroborated by an independent CVE report showing security scrutiny is active around auth flow vulnerabilities, though that CVE itself was about redirect URI validation, not brute-force. missing for 10: no explicit CAPTCHA/bot-detection feature documented, no independent hands-on validation of brute-force protection effectiveness.
